steps.title: Open & Load
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Grinder with the magnetic lid off, showing the micro-rounded teeth

bullets.text: Break up large buds by hand and place them **on the teeth** in the grinding chamber.
**Don't overfill.** Leave room for the lid to turn freely.

steps.title: Grind
steps.imageAlt: Hand holding the closed G Pen Grinder

bullets.text: Replace the lid and **twist back and forth** about **10 times**.
**Tap** the grinder a few times so ground material falls through to the collection chamber.

note.text: The **micro-rounded teeth** gently separate flower instead of shredding it, helping preserve terpenes and trichomes.

steps.title: Collect
steps.imageAlt: The G Pen Grinder's bottom collection chamber

bullets.text: Unscrew the **bottom chamber** to reach your ground material.
**No kief screen:** trichomes and kief stay mixed in with your flower.
Load it straight into your **Dash II** or **Dash+**.

steps.title: Clean
steps.imageAlt: Close-up of the G Pen Grinder's micro-rounded teeth

bullets.text: Brush leftover material out of the **teeth** and **chambers**.
For a deeper clean, soak the pieces in **isopropyl alcohol (ISO)**, then **rinse with water**.
Let every piece **dry completely** before reassembling and using it again.

faq.question: Why doesn't it have a kief screen?
faq.answer: The screenless 3-piece design keeps trichomes and kief mixed in with your ground flower instead of separating them out, so you get all of your flower in every session.

faq.question: What makes micro-rounded teeth different?
faq.answer: Instead of cutting and shredding like sharp teeth, the rounded teeth gently separate flower into a consistent grind. In independent testing by Orange Photonics, the micro-rounded design showed the highest post-grind THC retention of the grinder styles tested.

faq.question: The lid is hard to turn
faq.answer: The chamber is probably overfilled. Remove some flower, break up large buds by hand, and try again. If it still sticks, brush out any buildup around the teeth and threads.

faq.question: What grind works best in my Dash II or Dash+?
faq.answer: An even, consistent grind. About 10 twists and a few taps give you material that loads and heats evenly in the Dash II and Dash+.
